works.body:
はじめまして。
個人VTuberの 天羽シア（あまはね しあ） と申します。

この度、天羽シア（うちの子）のイラストをお願いしたく、リクエストを送らせていただきました。
詳しい参考資料は、以下のGoogleドライブにまとめております。

【リクエスト内容】
・キャラクター：天羽シア
・構図・ポーズ：おまかせ（可愛い雰囲気でお願いいたします）
・可能でしたら頭が切れないように全体を描いていただけると嬉しいです
・人物と背景を分けたPSD（またはレイヤー分けデータ）での納品ですと嬉しいです

【利用用途】
・ファンクラブでの利用
・X（旧Twitter）やYouTubeなどでの宣伝・告知素材として使用予定

素敵な作品を拝見し、ぜひ天羽シアを描いていただきたいと思いました。
ご検討のほど、よろしくお願いいたします。

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1l5SjlN7filydsDScqLx59kbkqUsHC3U5/view?usp=drivesdk

My name is Mikuri Hoshigoromo, a Vtuber belonging to UniVIRTUAL.

I like Sande-sama's illustrations very much, so I have made this request.

I would like her pose and facial expression to be cute!

Please
I would like to use it as a thumbnail,
If possible, we would appreciate a transparent PNG or PSD of the character only, with the address, background, etc. layered.

Reference Materials
We would appreciate it if you could refer to a standing picture of the clothes from the URL of the reference material. (We don't have a three-sided drawing yet, so you can just imagine what you can't see!)
I am an idol-type Vtuber.


I am an idol-type Vtuber.
Thumbnails for videos and distribution
Posting on SNS
Use as a calendar of images for fan sites to give back.
We would be grateful for your permission.

We understand that you are busy,
We would be very grateful if we could have a chance to work with you...!

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1fupDdByccmt70SUd8VBYocbg6TS4puIF/view?usp=drivesd

Buddha, sutras and priesthood

Hello, my name is Honoka Yokaya, and I am a Vtuber.
I saw your Skeb on X, and I would love to have you draw my character as well, so I made a new request.
Thank you very much for your consideration!

┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈
Intended use
(1) Non-profit use (I will not sell goods or the illustrations I received.
(2) Use in post images on X and use as thumbnails for distribution (Monetization is turned on for distribution.)

Character
Name: Honoka Yokaya
Height: 162 cm Personality: Energetic Age: Adult
Character Motif / Bear and checkered pattern. Her image color is blue-green (mint, Hatsune Miku's hair color).
When she smiles with her eyes closed, she has a troubled eyebrow.

Request Details
I would like you to leave the composition, pose, and situation to me!

If possible, we would appreciate it if you could give us a transparent version of the background in addition to the integrated version.
I would appreciate it if you could give me a transparent version of the background in addition to the integrated version.
I would appreciate it if you could give me a transparent version of the background as well as an integrated version of the background! 🙇‍♀️

We would appreciate your consideration!
┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈┈

Hello, my name is Tokito Hakumyo, a member of Re:AcT Gaming, active on Twitch and YouTube.
I am a member of Re:AcT Gaming and am active on Twitch and YouTube. I saw your illustration and really like the design and paint job, so I would like to make a request for you to draw it!
Usage
I would like to use your illustrations in my videos on my monetized channel and in my activities on my TV channel.
I would like to use your illustration for my activities on my monetized channel.
Requested contents
I would like to leave everything to you because I like the pattern and the paint very much!
I would like you to make another winter-like costume!
If the above is too difficult, we will be fine with the costumes shown in the materials!
If the above is too difficult for you, you can use the costumes from the reference materials!

We would appreciate it if the head and other parts of the illustration are not cut off for use in our activities!

We would like to receive a transparent png or PSD file of the background.
Thank you very much for your consideration.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1wkqLnDmy5usfQNVEbO3NOsh_vdaMztSl?usp=drive_link

Hello! I would like to request art of my vtuber character! She is a villainess! There are two versions in the drive link, you can choose which one you prefer to draw! One is her villainess form and one is her undercover form. 

You can choose the pose and expression. You can draw her in modern situations as well! I will use the illustration on social media, youtube, and twitch.

As a Villainess she is cruel, slightly crazy, but still protective of her ruined kingdom and throne. But she can be flustered and shy when she is embarrassed! Sometimes she is a bit silly. She can use shadow magic.

In her undercover form she is hiding in the modern-day world and enjoys reading villainess isekai comics, drinking coffee, and cooking. She gives off a calm feeling but she's still a villainess at heart!

Important design notes: She does not have human ears. She does not have a tail.

Thank you!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Gho4ZgPZntzqhR0AgjrJN0g_DXsyUITr?usp=drive_link
